_readme: Screens mounted on the map. Drop a video or image into assets/screens/ and
name it here — no code change needed.
media   a file in this folder. .mp4 / .webm play as video (muted, looping);
.png / .jpg / .gif show as a still. Leave it null for the built-in
where   'spawn' mounts one in each team's spawn room. Or give an explicit
pos/yaw to put it anywhere on the map.
bright  1.0 is a normal screen; push to 1.4 for a bright one.
A 16:9 video around 1280x720 is plenty — the panel is about 2.8 m wide and
players see it from a few metres away. Keep it under ~8 MB so the level does
not stall on a phone; it is fetched lazily and the placeholder shows until it
